'''0.27b''' is a minor update for [[Survarium]] that adjusted mission difficulty and to require equipment of the player's current faction rank.

==Changelog==
===Gameplay===
* The minimum level required for a [[missions|mission]] increased by 1. So now must use equipment of the current or previous level in order to perform mission from factions
* The difficulty of some missions has been increased so that it could correspond to the difficulty of most other missions; changed missions requiring headshots (15 headshots per day for gold), enemy kills (75 kills per day for gold), rewards (50 rewards per day for gold)
* Medkits stop working if while it’s increasing your health you sustain damage

===Bug Fixes===
* Fixed display of some weapons (no textures)
* Icons of [[premium weapons]] replaced with up-to-date ones
* Fixed bug which caused incorrect calculation of used up [[items]]
* Fixed display of the aftermatch statistics
* Text alerts associated with missions are fixed to something clearer ones
* Fixed sync error when changing equipment profile

==Hotfix 0.27b1==
===Gameplay===
* Reduced the cost of repairing items;

===Bug Fixes===
* Fixed some critical timing errors;
